title: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer Manual Volume2B
editionActuallyRead: Order253667-060US, September2016; downloaded document identifies this edition. No claim to have read the latest entire SDM.
readScope: MOVHPD, PDF pages79/80, printed4-78/4-79: instruction description, load/store distinctions, encoding and operation.
paraphrase: The legacy SSE2 66 0F16 memory-to-XMM form replaces the upper64 bits with the memory64 value and preserves the lower64 bits. This is a data transfer, with no SIMD floating-point arithmetic exception. Register-to-register form is unavailable. VEX/EVEX loads have different source and upper-register rules.
implementationScope: Proposed interpreter addition supports only the actually observed two-operand legacy memory64 load; VEX/EVEX/store and other unsupported forms still reject. It does not introduce CPU instructions or floating-point operations into the product kernel.
limits: Reading the manual is not an object/link audit. Replaying saved11 instruction records is not a new fullGNU artifact audit. Normal-artifact/command/complete numerical and sanitizer gates remain separate.
